convergence_baseline: R6 R1 (first round of phase-close convergence council)
summary: Install-lifecycle hardening + §4.33 legacy-path deletion are structurally sound at v1-beta. Step ordering for the 11-step pipeline correctly threads consent (Step 3) BEFORE expensive ed25519 peer-signature verify (Step 4 via validate_with_clock) per sec-r6r1-6 R6-FP-A reorder rationale, and §4.37 replay-defense is wired between (Step 3b). Legacy install-path deletion is verified structurally (absence pin + INTERNALS narrative + V1-FROZEN row). Two real findings: (F-1, MINOR) docstring on `pub fn install_plugin` documents the OLD pre-R6-FP-A step ordering (3=clock, 4=consent) — drift vs the current 3=consent-first, 4=clock implementation; the comment block at lines 797-824 also entirely omits Step 3b (§4.37 replay) and Step 7b (§4.41 caps-grew fresh-consent), both of which are real production gates with named typed ErrorCodes. (F-2, MAJOR) The end-to-end install_plugin × install_record_replay_check: Some(_) substantive test pin is absent — the only e2e test exercises the InstallRecordReplayStore primitive directly with a substrate proxy assertion (`GraphInternal.as_str() != empty`), violating pim-18 SHAPE-not-SUBSTANCE. Without the substantive pin, a regression that quietly stops invoking `replay_check()` at Step 3b would NOT be caught by the existing test family (a sentinel-presence test, not a behavioral pin). Both findings are fix-now per HARD RULE 12; both surgical (~15-50 LOC).

G-CORE-7 §4.41` at line 937 — those are the authoritative narratives; promote them into the pub-fn docstring 'Order:' block).

findings.title: §4.37 install-record replay-defense end-to-end test pin is SHAPE-not-SUBSTANCE (no test wires `install_record_replay_check: Some(_)` through install_plugin)
findings.evidence: The named test 'install_record_replay_rejected_pre_cap_cascade_not_post_rollback' (lines 223-283) asserts (a) `ErrorCode::GraphInternal.as_str().is_empty() == false` as a 'Step-9-class ErrorCode' substrate proxy, and (b) the `InstallRecordReplayStore::record_and_check` primitive's atomic check-and-record contract. Neither arm exercises the WIRE-UP through `install_plugin` — i.e. nobody calls `install_plugin(.., InstallPorts { install_record_replay_check: Some(&mut |hash| store.record_and_check(*hash)), ..}, ..)` twice with the same install record and asserts the second call returns `Err(ErrorCode::PluginInstallRecordAlreadyApplied)` from the install pipeline. The test's own commentary admits this: 'SHIPPED-SURFACE EXERCISE: the substrate at HEAD is the SHIPPED install pipeline ordering' + 'exercise the SHIPPED ErrorCode discriminator on a Step-9-class error to anchor the structural contract.' This is precisely the SHAPE-not-SUBSTANCE pattern pim-18 §3.6f exists to surface: sentinel-presence asserts presence; no would-FAIL-if-no-op'd behavioral pin.
findings.would_fail_test_marker: A regression that quietly removed the `if let Some(replay_check) = ports.install_record_replay_check.as_mut() { … }` block at lines 901-905 of plugin_lifecycle.rs would NOT cause any existing test to fail: the InstallRecordReplayStore primitive tests still pass (the primitive itself is unchanged) AND the substrate-proxy `GraphInternal.as_str()` non-emptiness assertion still passes. The would-FAIL behavior the §4.37 contract names ('second presentation of the same canonical signing-payload bytes is rejected with typed PluginInstallRecordAlreadyApplied; zero duplicate-mint window per the §4.37 TOCTOU contract' per the comment at line 887) is not pinned at the install_plugin boundary.
findings.fix_proposal: Add ONE substantive end-to-end test in `crates/benten-platform-foundation/tests/` (sibling of the existing r6fp_a_plugin_trust_blocker_closures.rs harness): (1) build a minimal valid PluginManifest + InstallRecord signed by a test user-DID; (2) construct `InstallPorts { install_record_replay_check: Some(&mut |hash| store.record_and_check(*hash)), .. }` wrapping a fresh `InstallRecordReplayStore`; (3) first `install_plugin(..)` call succeeds (`InstallOutcome.grants_minted > 0`, `store.consumed_count() == 1`); (4) second call with identical install_record returns `Err(ErrorCode::PluginInstallRecordAlreadyApplied)` and `store.consumed_count()` is still 1 (zero double-record) and `library.entries.len()` is still 1 (zero double-install). ~80-150 LOC test (reuses existing test helper patterns in r6fp_a_plugin_trust_blocker_closures.rs). Couples Engine + platform-foundation across the install_record_replay seam — placement: `crates/benten-platform-foundation/tests/g_core_8_install_record_replay_wired_through_install_plugin.rs` (platform-foundation tests already exercise install_plugin; benten-engine tests don't include platform-foundation).
